mentions.name: Suno song covers
mentions.description: A music project featuring AI-generated covers of two songs written by the author, created using Suno, with plans to add human-performed versions and eventually make electronic music.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also making music. I got Suno to do a cover of 2 songs I wrote, although eventually I want to introduce human versions. Also want to make electronic music eventually.
